name: omp-rsi
description: Git-backed agent memory, shared plans, policy and RSI for Oh My Pi

base.description: Absolute local memory directory; takes effect after restarting OMP.

agentId.description: Local agent ID for memory entries; takes effect after restarting OMP.

typesafeEnabled.description: Allow explicit remote TypeSafe assessments. Set TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the OMP process environment; restart OMP.

rsiInstructionDiscoveryEnabled.description: Allow explicit local instruction and skill discovery; combined with TypeSafe may disclose selected bodies. Restart OMP.

rsiTelemetryEnabled.description: Collect tool-result metadata for explicitly requested local observations; restart OMP.
